svg.title: LumaScan batch edit UI UX flow
svg.desc: Figma-style product design board showing eight mobile screens for selecting, editing, organizing, and exporting multiple scanned pages.
svg.text: One visual system for selecting, enhancing, organizing and exporting many pages.

g.text: Tap Select pages or long-press any page.
Selected count stays visible; Select all is reversible.
Changes apply to selected pages only
Options adapt to the current selection.
Rotate all; review individual crop boundaries.
Hold and drag to reorder · 4 selected
Drag, or use accessible move actions.
Format, quality, OCR and size stay visible.
You can leave this screen safely.
Every batch action has a visible state.
No selection; single-page actions remain available.
Count, Select all and Cancel are persistent.
Before/after; apply scope is named on the CTA.
Progress is resumable and safe to leave.
Show actual output and next actions.
Keep successful pages; identify pages needing review.
Name the count and provide timed Undo.

svg.text: LumaScan · Batch edit UX flow · SVG master board · 3200 × 2240 · Source of truth: product requirements, screen design and current Flutter feature set
